arts.ttl: Borussia Dortmund vs. Villarreal: UEFA Champions League LIVE blog and team news
arts.sum: Borussia Dortmund will hope to put their recent UEFA Champions League defeat at Manchester City firmly behind them when they welcome Villarreal to Signal Iduna Park on Tuesday (kick-off: 9pm CET). The Yellow Submarine have yet to claim their first victory of the Champions League league phase this season, drawing with Juventus but losing to Tottenham Hotspur, Man City and Cypriot outfit Pafos.
